name: Meteor Jobs: AI Job Search
tagline: AI job search for iPhone: discover matches, tailor resumes, and queue applications.
description:
Meteor is an AI job search service with an iPhone app, Meteor Jobs: AI Job Search. It helps job seekers find relevant roles, prepare application materials, and keep track of application progress.

On iPhone, browse a swipeable deck of matched roles, open full job descriptions, refine role and location preferences, and save opportunities. Swipe left to skip a role or right to queue an application. Upload a resume, review your profile and saved answers, and choose application and resume-tailoring preferences.

Meteor uses saved details to fill applications through supported employer portals. A queued application is not confirmation that it has been submitted. Check application progress and respond when more information is needed. Review your information and AI-generated materials before using them.

Meteor's wider service provides:
100,000+ job listings.
50,000+ company career pages.
30+ supported ATS platforms.

These are catalogue and platform coverage figures, not user counts or hiring outcomes. Individual vacancies can change or close, and application support varies by source.

Meteor is freemium. The Free plan includes a one-time allowance of 25 auto-applies and 25 resume tailors; this allowance does not renew monthly. Paid plans offer higher usage limits. The iPhone app requires a Meteor account and internet access. Meteor does not guarantee interviews or job offers.

Download Meteor for iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6829431251
Learn more: https://usemeteor.ai/
